svg.title: Preformed hexadecylamine/stearate-capped CdSe nanocrystals: identity only
svg.desc: Preformed input synthesized by external reference 28; no upstream synthesis is reconstructed. 7.5 nm is source-estimated from the 645 nm first exciton; phase and measured atomic coordinates are not reported. No molecular or crystal model is assigned.
